description: This Java test class, ImmutableFunctionExpressionTest, verifies the behavior, immutability, and supported functions of the ImmutableFunctionExpression class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It contains tests for function support, exceptions, and actual function resolution logic.

classes.name: ImmutableFunctionExpressionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ImmutableFunctionExpression functionality and behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFunctionExpression instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations of ImmutableFunctionExpression.

methods.name: testSupportedNames
methods.description: Checks that the supported function names include the expected ones.

methods.name: testCompletenessOfRegisteredFunctions
methods.description: Ensures each expected function name is supported by the ImmutableFunctionExpression.

methods.name: testUnknownFunction
methods.description: Tests that an unknown function call throws the correct exception.

methods.name: testFunctionUpper
methods.description: Verifies the 'upper' function converts input to uppercase.

methods.name: testFunctionUpperWrongSignature
methods.description: Ensures wrong signatures for 'upper' throw an exception.

methods.name: testFunctionLower
methods.description: Verifies the 'lower' function converts input to lowercase.

methods.name: testFunctionLowerWrongSignature
methods.description: Ensures wrong signatures for 'lower' throw an exception.

methods.name: testFunctionDefaultWhenInputPresent
methods.description: Tests the default function when input is present.

methods.name: testFunctionDefaultWhenInputEmptyWithConstant
methods.description: Tests default function with empty input and a constant.

methods.name: testFunctionDefaultWhenInputEmptyWithConstantDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Tests default function with empty input using double quotes.

methods.name: testFunctionDefaultWhenInputEmptyWithPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests default function with placeholder input.

methods.name: testFunctionDefaultWithWrongSignature
methods.description: Verifies that wrong signatures for default throw an exception.

methods.name: testFunctionSubstringBefore
